requiredBehaviors.behavior: record failing acceptance-oriented Red evidence before production changes
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The acceptance command, expected missing behavior, and actual failing output are captured before any production file changes.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: implement the smallest end-to-end path that makes the acceptance check Green
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Only the required layers for the single observable behavior are changed, and the original acceptance check passes.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: refactor only after Green and verify focused plus relevant regression checks
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Cleanup begins only after Green; focused, contract, and relevant regression commands remain successful.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: weaken assertions or delete failing tests to obtain Green
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The original acceptance assertions remain intact and no failing test is removed or skipped.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: expand into unrelated behavior or broad infrastructure work
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The diff remains limited to the bounded vertical behavior and required verification seams.
